output.population: 12 right-handed adults (4 female, 8 male), age range 23-30, native Mandarin Chinese speakers recruited from universities in Beijing
output.summary: Synchronized multimodal dataset for brain language processing: fMRI and MEG from the same participants listening to naturalistic stories, plus structural and diffusion MRI, resting-state fMRI, and rich linguistic annotations of the stimuli.
